# kmcurvely

The goal of kmcurvely is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of kmcurvely from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("MSDLLCPapers/kmcurvely")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

# Example usage of kmcurvely function

meta <- meta_tte_example()
kmcurvely(meta = meta,
           population = "apat",
           observation = "efficacy_population",
           endpoint = "pfs;os",
           subgroup = "male;female")
```

# Package index

## Time-to-event analysis

- [`meta_tte_example()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/meta_tte_example.md)
  : Example Function for Time-to-Event Analysis
- [`kmcurvely_static()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/kmcurvely_static.md)
  : Generate Static KM plot by endpoints and subgroups and save as
  RTF/PNG files
- [`kmcurvely()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/kmcurvely.md)
  : Generate interactive KM plot by endpoints and subgroups

## Examples

- [`kmcurvely_adsl`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/kmcurvely_adsl.md)
  : ADSL dataset
- [`kmcurvely_adtte`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/kmcurvely_adtte.md)
  : ADTTE dataset
- [`km_extract()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/km_extract.md)
  : Extract Survival Estimates
- [`kmcurvely_static()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/kmcurvely_static.md)
  : Generate Static KM plot by endpoints and subgroups and save as
  RTF/PNG files
- [`meta_tte_example()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/meta_tte_example.md)
  : Example Function for Time-to-Event Analysis
- [`meta_tte_example_new()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/meta_tte_example_new.md)
  : Example Function for Time-to-Event Analysis
- [`check_args()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/check_args.md)
  : Check Argument Types, Length or Dimension
- [`prepare_hr_forestly()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/prepare_hr_forestly.md)
  : Prepare the dataset for the HR forest plot, alongwith its KM plots
- [`format_hr_forestly()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/format_hr_forestly.md)
  : Format the outdata for the HR forest plot, along with its KM plots
- [`hr_forestly()`](https://merck.github.io/kmcurvely/reference/hr_forestly.md)
  : Display the HR forest plot, along with its KM plots
